about: Regression for the v1.4.6 step culling (mood, prison, milk, pregnancy and gold froze for cells off-screen). Self-checking: phase 1 turns step culling ON and expects off-screen cells to freeze, which proves the probe can see culling; phase 2 uses the shipped default (culling OFF) and expects them to keep running.

steps.why: camera at the bottom floor: floors 0-3 are off-screen
control: re-enable the v1.4.6 step culling
with culling on, off-screen cells must be frozen (else the probe is blind)
with culling off, off-screen cells keep working
